atmosphere stars.disposition: The same Sun and aerosol in the clouds-off arm control for clear-air refresh work. Separating chart refreshes from overlay and dependent work remains open.

effect 0: effect 1: cloud weather map.disposition: The same scene, Sun and extent give a pass-level clouds-off control. Any residual difference remains open for an isolated pass trace.

effect 1: effect 1: cloud Sun path near.disposition: The occurrence counts check whether refresh frequency changed. Any residual per-refresh increase remains open for an isolated fixed-Sun versus advancing-Sun capture.

effect 2: effect 1: cloud Sun path middl.disposition: The occurrence counts check whether refresh frequency changed. Any residual per-refresh increase remains open for an isolated fixed-Sun versus advancing-Sun capture.

effect 3: effect 1: cloud Sun path far.disposition: The occurrence counts check whether refresh frequency changed. Any residual per-refresh increase remains open for an isolated fixed-Sun versus advancing-Sun capture.

effect 4: effect 1: cloud ground field.disposition: The same scene, Sun and extent give a pass-level clouds-off control. Any residual difference remains open for an isolated pass trace.

effect 8: effect 1: cloud sky overlay.disposition: Compare the pass at dry and occupied samples with the same render extent. The effect has no clouds-off counterpart. Separating occupied ray work from pass and queue overhead remains open.

synthetic Sun horizon heights.disposition: The same scene, Sun and extent give a pass-level clouds-off control. Any residual difference remains open for an isolated pass trace.

synthetic Sun shadow far.disposition: The same scene, Sun and extent give a pass-level clouds-off control. Any residual difference remains open for an isolated pass trace.

synthetic tone encode.disposition: The same scene, Sun and extent give a pass-level clouds-off control. Any residual difference remains open for an isolated pass trace.

whole frame.disposition: The paired totals include the same solar windows and show the full cost with and without the cloud graph. Whole-frame tuning belongs to the performance phase.
